related.title: Python iterator：惰性管線與單次消耗
related.titleEn: Python iterators: lazy pipelines and one-pass consumption
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付object-graph.json與identity測試；不可依賴實際id數字跨執行相同。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver object-graph.json and identity assertions without expecting numeric IDs to persist across runs. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 每次next記錄input位置及yield；比較generator、list materialization與重新建立generator三路。
related.differenceEn: Trace input position and yield at each next; compare a generator, a materialized list and a freshly recreated generator.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
名稱綁定到物件；賦值不自動複製。淺複製只複製外層容器，內層可變元素仍可共享。
本課數值核對：1+1 = 2 outer_objects；另一項核對：2+2 = 4 total_lists。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

iterator有消耗狀態；iterable可提供新的iterator。generator延遲計算但不自動提供可重播快照。
本課數值核對：0+4+16+36+64 = 120 sum；另一項核對：10/2 = 5 items。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Names bind objects and assignment does not automatically copy. A shallow copy duplicates only the outer container while mutable children may remain shared.
Numeric audit: 1+1 = 2 outer_objects; second audit: 2+2 = 4 total_lists. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Iterators carry consumption state while iterables can supply new iterators. Generators delay work but do not automatically provide replayable snapshots.
Numeric audit: 0+4+16+36+64 = 120 sum; second audit: 10/2 = 5 items. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: LLVM SSA：phi 節點與控制流合流
related.titleEn: LLVM SSA: phi nodes and control-flow merges
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付object-graph.json與identity測試；不可依賴實際id數字跨執行相同。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver object-graph.json and identity assertions without expecting numeric IDs to persist across runs. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 畫四基本區塊及前驅邊，為phi列(value,label)；逐一路徑執行而非只看程式文字順序。
related.differenceEn: Draw four basic blocks and predecessor edges, list phi(value,label) pairs and execute each path separately.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
名稱綁定到物件；賦值不自動複製。淺複製只複製外層容器，內層可變元素仍可共享。
本課數值核對：1+1 = 2 outer_objects；另一項核對：2+2 = 4 total_lists。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

SSA值只定義一次；phi在合流時依實際前驅選值，不是把兩個分支同時計算相加。
本課數值核對：10+3 = 13 result；另一項核對：20+3 = 23 result。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Names bind objects and assignment does not automatically copy. A shallow copy duplicates only the outer container while mutable children may remain shared.
Numeric audit: 1+1 = 2 outer_objects; second audit: 2+2 = 4 total_lists. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

SSA values are defined once; a phi selects the value from the actual predecessor at a merge rather than summing both branches.
Numeric audit: 10+3 = 13 result; second audit: 20+3 = 23 result. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
